name: Fluorexetamine
summary: Fluorexetamine (3'-fluoro-2-oxo-PCE, 3-FXE) is a recreational designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, with dissociative effects. It has reportedly been sold over the internet since around 2017, though has remained relatively uncommon.org that all their previously analyzed samples of fluorexetamine actually contained 2'-fluoro-2-oxo-PCE (2-FXE, also known as CanKet) rather than 3'-fluoro-2-oxo PCE (3-FXE).
